title: LLM Model Quantization & I/O
summary: This module provides functionalities for quantizing large language models to optimize their size and performance, alongside utilities for handling GGUF file metadata and managing the Key-Value (KV) cache during model inference. It also includes core memory mapping implementations for efficient file access.

nodes.label: Quantize LLM Model
nodes.title: Model Quantization
nodes.description: Performs quantization on an input LLM model file, converting it to a more memory-efficient format (e.g., GGUF) and saving the output.

nodes.label: Convert GGUF KV to String
nodes.title: GGUF Key-Value String Conversion
nodes.description: Converts a GGUF key-value pair, including arrays and strings, into a human-readable string representation for metadata handling.

nodes.label: Add KV Cache Position
nodes.title: KV Cache Position Addition
nodes.description: Adjusts the position of a sequence within the KV cache by adding a delta, handling negative positions by removing the sequence.

nodes.label: Divide KV Cache Position
nodes.title: KV Cache Position Division
nodes.description: Divides the position of a sequence in the KV cache by a given divisor, updating the shift accordingly.

nodes.label: Keep KV Cache Sequence
nodes.title: KV Cache Sequence Retention
nodes.description: Manages the retention of a specific sequence within the KV cache, resetting or updating its position and associated metadata.

nodes.label: Remove KV Cache Entry
nodes.title: KV Cache Entry Removal
nodes.description: Removes a specific entry from the KV cache, resetting its position, sequence associations, and shift values.

nodes.label: Memory Map Implementation
nodes.title: Memory Mapping Details
nodes.description: Represents the underlying implementation details for memory-mapped file operations, crucial for efficient model loading and access.

groups.label: Model Quantization
groups.title: Model Quantization Process
groups.description: Handles the conversion of large language models into more compact, quantized formats for reduced memory footprint and faster inference.

groups.label: GGUF I/O & Metadata
groups.title: GGUF Input/Output and Metadata Handling
groups.description: Manages the reading and writing of GGUF file format metadata, including conversion of key-value pairs to string representations.

groups.label: KV Cache Management
groups.title: Key-Value Cache Management
groups.description: Provides utilities for manipulating the Key-Value cache, including adding, dividing, keeping, and removing sequence positions to optimize memory usage during inference.

groups.label: Memory Mapping
groups.title: Memory Mapping Utilities
groups.description: Encapsulates the core implementation details for memory-mapped file operations, enabling efficient direct access to model data from disk.
